C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to award on­call municipal engineering services agreement to Willdan
  Engineering for engineering and architectural design, surveying, geotechnical and traffic
  engineering, grant administration, project management, engineering support, Public Works permit
  administration, plan check, and labor compliance services.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, presented the staff report.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, spoke.

  Councilmember Roa spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem De Paula spoke.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Mayor Farfan spoke.

  A discussion ensued between Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, and the City Council.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem De Paula, seconded by Mayor Farfan, to approve
  recommendation.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Roa, Vargas, De Paula, Farfan
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Del Rio
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0
